description: Minimal grants for the companion's single window: subscribe to the events the client re-emits from the desktop's stream, scan the pairing QR, and open external links in the phone's browser. The opener needs BOTH entries: `allow-open-url` grants the command and `allow-default-urls` grants the http/https URL SCOPE, and without the scope the command is permitted and then every call is refused -- silently, so the link simply does nothing. App-defined commands registered via generate_handler! are not ACL-gated and need no entry here. The stronghold plugin's JS commands are deliberately NOT granted: the Rust side owns the store (src/store.rs) and the webview never reads a seed.
